rubric_items.reason: All nine known REQs are traced. S-1 covers REQ-1/2/3/6, S-2 covers REQ-4/5 and S-3 covers REQ-7/8/9. The intent has no assumed or unknown REQs.
Each story has one user-facing outcome. S-1 still bundles placement, two counts and the counting window, but each part has its own AC.

All ACs are Given/When/Then and can be checked. The new S-2 AC4 catches date-based counting, S-1 AC5 catches an unscoped count and S-3 AC5 covers the no-medical-history case. Only a minor gap remains: no empty appointments-list case for REQ-7.
Every value comes from the intent or the cited glossary Period. The 2 January 2025 date is an example, and the AC gives its reason inline (outside any Last 30 days period).
Status names, Visit summary and patient page are named the same way throughout and match the glossary. The front matter, body and resolves lines agree.

findings.text: REQ-7 (appointments list unchanged) is tested only for a patient with upcoming+past or only past appointments. There is no case for a patient with no appointments, where the list's empty state sits next to the new Visit summary.

cites.quote: Given a patient with only past appointments and no upcoming one, when staff open the patient page
The patient page's appointments list is `unchanged`.

findings.suggested_fix: Optionally add an S-3 AC: Given a patient with no appointments, when staff open the patient page, then the appointments list shows the same empty-state content as before the change.

cites.quote: The patient page shows a `Visit summary` above the appointments list.
The Visit summary shows the number of the patient's `Completed` appointments.
The Visit summary shows the number of the patient's `No-show` appointments.
`Scheduled and Cancelled` appointments are not counted in either number.
A patient with no Completed or No-show appointments shows `0 for each`.
Both counts cover `All time`: every Completed and No-show appointment of the patient, with no period picker.
The patient page's appointments list is `unchanged`.
The patient page's `medical history` is unchanged.
`The rest of the patient page` is unchanged apart from the new Visit summary.
The patient page already lists the patient's appointments, `upcoming first, then past`.
A past appointment the patient did not attend, closed instead of staying Scheduled.
A run of whole hospital-local days ending today: Today, Last 7 days or Last 30 days.
